brief: Describes an elementwise GPU computation with vectors, scalars and one assignment, and has the engine generate and check the WGSL kernel.
detail: Declare the inputs with TakesVector, the parameters with TakesScalar, the output with ReturnsVector and the body with ForEachElement, an assignment such as { @C = alpha * @A + @B }. ToWGSL returns the generated kernel verbatim, nothing hidden, and needs no GPU, so kernels can be written and inspected on a machine without one. Anything outside the declared names and the allowed functions refuses at ToWGSL with a message naming it. Limits: up to 5 input vectors, 14 scalars and exactly one output; every value is f32 on the device. Hand the maker to stzGpu to run it.
receiver:
o1 = new stzKernelMaker
o1.TakesVector(:A)
o1.TakesVector(:B)
o1.TakesScalar(:alpha)
o1.ReturnsVector(:C)
o1.ForEachElement("{ @C = alpha * @A + @B }")
